preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= m <= 10**6 for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
preconditions.description: For each test case, n (number of residents/cats) and m (number of friendships) satisfy 1 ≤ n ≤ m ≤ 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n and 1 <= b_i <= n for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n') and ' ' in line)
preconditions.description: Each friendship pair (a_i, b_i) has resident and cat indices between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(any(a_i == b_i == i for i in range(1, n+1)) for n, m in (line.split() for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() and not line.startswith('\n')))
preconditions.description: For each resident i, there exists a friendship pair (i, i) (i.e., each resident is acquainted with their own cat).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip() == 'Yes' and any('Yes' in line for line in stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: Output is either 'No' (impossible) or starts with 'Yes' (possible) followed by valid jury and contestant selections.
If 'Yes', the output must include exactly 4 lines: 'Yes', j and p, jury members, and contestant cats.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'Yes' and (j := int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split()[0])) >= 1 and (p := int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1].split()[1])) >= 1 and j + p == n)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the number of jury members (j) and contestants (p) must satisfy j ≥ 1, p ≥ 1, and j + p = n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'Yes' and (jury := set(map(int, stdout.strip().splitlines()[2].split()))) and (contestants := set(map(int, stdout.strip().splitlines()[3].split()))) and len(jury) == j and len(contestants) == p)
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', the jury and contestant lists must contain exactly j and p distinct integers, respectively.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'Yes' and all(a_i not in contestants for a_i in jury) and all(b_i not in jury for b_i in contestants))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', no jury member is acquainted with any contestant cat, and no contestant cat is owned by a jury member (i.e., no resident in jury is acquainted with any cat in contestants).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'No' or (stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'Yes' and all(1 <= x <= n for x in jury) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in contestants))
postconditions.description: If 'Yes', all jury members and contestant cats are within the valid range [1, n].
